payload.payload: C1.3 CI mutation + coverage jobs: added 3 unique jobs (coverage, mutations, mutations-weekly) to .github/workflows/ci.yml + [profile.mutants] in Cargo.toml. Existing ci job untouched. checkout@v4 all; fetch-depth:0 only on mutations. coverage: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable + llvm-tools-preview + taiki-e/install-action@v2 cargo-llvm-cov, then cargo llvm-cov -p polyforge-core -p polyforge-toolrunner --all-features --fail-under-lines 80 --fail-under-file-lines 80 (native exit code is the gate). mutations: diff-scoped via git.diff + --in-diff, empty-scope skip guard via cargo mutants --list --json --in-diff, test-file-any-change escape to un-scoped full suite, fail on survivors exit 2. mutations-weekly: cron '0 3 * * 1', full --in-place --no-shuffle, hard-fail on survivors, upload-artifact@v7 if always, no gh-issue escalation. Commit 134f0d3, 2 files +112/-2.
